en.description: Coordination server for parallel coding agents working in one repository. Transport: stdio (`tirith stdio`) or Streamable HTTP at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/mcp`, with a live dashboard at `http://127.0.0.1:7477/`; local daemon, no auth, no telemetry, no embeddings.
